title: Artbook
summary: The Artbook is a unique book that contains an extensive collection of production art and original designs from Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, ranging from Seekers and Titans, to artifacts and locations. It was printed in 2009 and contains more than 158 pages, written in English and Italian. It was put on display to the general public in 2019 at the Milan Comic Museum as part of 15 Years of Magic exhibition celebrating 15 years of Huntik's sister series, Winx Club. The exhibition ran from January 26 to May 12, 2019.

{{Infobox book 2|name = The Artbook|image = File:Artbook.png|writer = [[Iginio Straffi]]|publisher = Rainbow SpA|published = {{Country|IT}} January 26, 2019|pages = 160}}
The '''Artbook''' is a unique book that contains an extensive collection of production art and original designs from [[Season 1]] of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'', ranging from [[Seekers]] and [[Titans]], to artifacts and locations. It was printed in 2009 and contains more than 158 pages, written in English and Italian. It was put on display to the general public in 2019 at the Milan Comic Museum as part of ''15 Years of Magic'' exhibition celebrating 15 years of ''Huntik's'' sister series, ''Winx Club''. The exhibition ran from January 26 to May 12, 2019.
